name: A Heart of Crystal
summary: Historian Biraxas asks you to recover a Depleted Crystal Heart from a failing pylon protector. The remaining pylon guards may not endure forever.

sections.title: A Failing Guard
sections.body: Historian Biraxas, within the temple of Shen'dralas, asks you to bring him a Depleted Crystal Heart. The unstable rifts you encountered are precursors to the pylon guards, and Biraxas says his people have been unable to conjure more for centuries. He fears what may happen when the remaining guards fail.

faq.q: Who is asking for the Crystal Heart?
faq.answer: Historian Biraxas asks you to recover a Depleted Crystal Heart and bring it to him within the temple of Shen'dralas.

faq.q: What is a Depleted Crystal Heart from?
faq.answer: It comes from a Decrepit Pylon Protector that is nearly on the verge of collapse.

faq.q: Why does Biraxas want the heart?
faq.answer: Biraxas says unstable rifts are precursors to pylon guards, and he worries because no more guards have been conjured for centuries.

faq.q: Where do I bring the heart?
faq.answer: Bring the Depleted Crystal Heart to Historian Biraxas within the temple of Shen'dralas.
